topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: The space above is cramped, the air heavy and stale. I move carefully, the boards creaking underfoot. Shadows dance as the light from the small window barely reaches the corners. Items loom out of the darkness, shapes I’ve never seen before. Each step makes me hesitate. The silence is thick, pressing against my ears. I don’t want to touch anything, to stir whatever rest lies here. The quicker I look, the quicker I can return to the safety of the familiar rooms below. But the longer I stay, the more the silence seems to whisper, urging me to hurry, to leave these silent witnesses behind.
